description: This file defines the StandardAoTCalculatorPage class, which provides UI automation methods and properties for interacting with the calculator in Standard / AoT mode during UI testing. It includes methods for navigating modes, retrieving tooltips, checking button presence, and resizing the window to display certain elements.

classes.name: StandardAoTCalculatorPage
classes.description: Provides UI automation methods for interacting with the calculator in Standard / AoT mode during UI testing.

methods.name: NavigateToStandardMode
methods.description: Navigates from AoT mode to Standard mode by clicking the appropriate button and verifying the header.

methods.name: NavigateToStandardAoTMode
methods.description: Ensures the calculator is in AoT mode by clicking the 'Enter Always On Top' button and verifying absence of header.

methods.name: GetAoTToolTipText
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip text for the AoT button.

methods.name: IsKeepOnTopButtonPresent
methods.description: Checks if the 'Keep on top' button is present in the UI.

methods.name: IsInAlwaysOnTopMode
methods.description: Determines if the calculator is currently in AoT (Keep on top) mode.

methods.name: ResizeAoTWindowToDisplayInvertButton
methods.description: Resizes the calculator window to ensure the invert button is visible.

methods.name: GrowWindowToShowInvertButton
methods.description: Recursively increases window height until the invert button is visible or maximum height is exceeded.
